catalog.page.auto_colour_game.text_0:
TRIGGERS:
5x Repeat Effect
1x User Stuff Collision
1x Furni Double Clicked
1x Group Member


EFFECTS:
4x Don’t Chase Top
1x Teleport User
5x Match Furni
1x Random Effect

CONDITIONS:
6x Furni States and Positions Match
1x Furni DOESN’T Match
1x Furni Matches



STEP 1:
Take 4 of your TRIGGER: REPEAT EFFECT and lay them out separately, set them to 0.5 delay. Then, stack EFFECT: DON’T CHASE TOP on each of them, and CONDITION: FURNI STATES AND POSITIONS MATCH after on each stack.

STEP 2:
Set each of your EFFECT: DON’T CHASE TOP to one of the rollers that users stand on after they’ve picked their colour, one per stack.

STEP 3:
Take your CONDITION: FURNI STATES AND POSITIONS MATCH and set it to one of the coloured spheres you are using when it is out of its resting place. You will have one sphere selected per stack. Also, make sure current position in room is ticked.

STEP 4:
Make a new stack consisting of TRIGGER: USER STUFF COLLISION, EFFECT: TELEPORT USER, and CONDITION: FURNI MATCHES. Set your EFFECT: TELEPORT USER to an item in your waiting area, and set your CONDITION: FURNI TYPE MATCHES to all 4 of the rollers you are using.

STEP 5:
Make a new stack consisting of TRIGGER: FURNI DOUBLE CLICKED, 4x EFFECT: MATCH FURNI, CONDITION: GROUP MEMBER. EFFECT: RANDOM EFFECT and CONDITION: FURNI MATCHES.

STEP 6:
Take your TRIGGER: FURNI DOUBLE CLICKED and set it to the switch/button you will be using to send the spheres into the game area. Then, take 4x EFFECT: MATCH FURNIand set them to a sphere when they are in the game area in the position you want, one per wired box and make sure to tick current position in room. After that, take your CONDITION: FURNI STATES AND POSITIONS MATCH and set it to a random item in your game that will stay in that one place the entire game, make sure to click current position in room.

STEP 7:
Make another stack with the following wired: TRIGGER: REPEAT EFFECT, 1x EFFECT: MATCH FURNI, CONDITION: FURNI MATCHES, and FURNI DOESN’T MATCH.

STEP 8:
First, set your TRIGGER: REPEAT EFFECT to a 2 second delay. Then, take your EFFECT: MATCH FURNI STATE/HEIGHT/POSITION and set it to a 2 second delay, then set it to all 4 of your spheres when they are in their resting place, make sure to tick off current position in room. Do the exact same with your CONDITION: FURNI DOESN’T MATCH. Lastly, take your CONDITION FURNI MATCHES and set it to a random item in your game, make sure to tick off current position in room.

Test this by having someone choose a colour in your game, flick the switch and if the ball matches the colour they’re in it should kick them out.

catalog.page.christmas_hub.text_0:
Poker Chips

Purchaseable via Diamonds, and taxed in Credits, Poker Chips provide you an new opportunity to grow your wealth, and afford the kind of rooms you want to build!

Gambling & Trading

True to its namesake, Poker Chips make for the perfect currency to gamble or trade amongst other players within the community. Simply trade, or use your pay commands to get started!

Exchange

As a premier currency, your Poker Chips can also be traded in for an assortment of Classic Rares, Custom Rares, and other unlockable items. Simply double click your Poker Chip exchange furniture, or use the :redeem command while they are placed in your inventory to start buying today!
catalog.page.clothing_shop.text_0:
Hubbly Clothing Shop

Step into style- whether you're rocking a legendary hair cut, repping your house with wizarding robes, or making a bold statement with limited-edition and seasonal clothing, our catalog has everything you need to turn your avatar into an absolute icon!



Mix, match, and express yourself like never before- your next favorite outfit is just a click away!

Limited Edition Clothing

Limited Edition clothing isn’t just stylish- it’s an investment. As these rare items vanish from circulation over time, their value rises, making them prized possessions for collectors and traders alike. Own a piece of Hubbly history before it’s gone for good!

Seasonal Clothing

Seasonal clothing brings flair and exclusivity that shifts with the calendar- think spooky fits for Halloween or cozy winter wear. Their availability is fleeting, and as the season fades, demand and trade value often soar. Smart collectors know: timing is everything.

catalog.page.introduction.text_0:
Rare Values

Our system tracks sales made via Marketplace to provide users with the most accurate, and up-to-date information. Sale prices are averaged out to determine approximate value, and the Marketplace page on the website displays vital sales information in an easy-to-understand visual graph to give you a better feel for its history.

Clicking on any item in the Rare Values interface in-game will bring up a list of users who own that specific item, how many they own, as well inactive items on staff accounts so make hunting your favourite items much easier!

Credits

Credits are easily earned by completing tasks in your Event Journal, accepting your drop-downs every 15 minutes, or by staying online.

Online activity is rewarded every 30 minutes with 250 Credits and 1 Diamond. This number is increased depending on which VIP Tier you hold. You can find out more information about our VIP Packages by clicking here

Diamonds

Diamonds are primarily earned through activity, completing achievements, playing Automatic Games in The Hub, as well as commpleting certain tasks in your Event Journal.

Depending on the complexity of the auto-game, the Credit & Diamond payouts will match... plus- it qualifies you to win the GOTW Prize, which is even more Diamonds and Credits :D

Poker Chips

Purchaseable via Credits, and taxed in Diamonds, Poker Chips provide you an new opportunity to grow your wealth, and collect the kind of rares you want!

The intention of the Poker Shop is to keep currency actively moving, and getting rooms built so credits and diamonds don't just sit and collect dust on your account, which can generally result in a decreased value of currency. These rares are charged at a slightly premium price for the convenience.

Before going any further, it is important to note, and follow the rules we have set out to ensure Hubbly maintains a fair and stable economy. Failure to abide by the following rules will result in your immediate termination and account wipe.

1) Do not give out any rares in this section to regular users without authorization from Management.

2)You may use these items to build, however you must own the room you are using them to build in.

3) You may not trade, transfer, or otherwise move any furnitur from this section; this includes moving it into a public category using the Catafix commands.
